ideas.name: any warning after the day's last warning worked
ideas.why: warnings pay in a rotating market; if today's last resolved warning reached its target first, the day is rotating, and if it failed, the day is trending through them

ideas.name: any warning just off a round 100, calling away
ideas.why: round hundreds collect resting orders and option strikes; a warning that calls price away from one it touched in the last 5 minutes has those orders behind it

ideas.name: any warning after a volatility burst
ideas.why: a burst of range (the last 5 bars' average over 1.5x the hour before) is a flush or a squeeze; once it runs out of forced orders, a turn is more likely

ideas.name: any warning with volume flow already turned
ideas.why: price rose over 30 minutes while the volume of down bars beat up bars (or the reverse): the move is running on thin participation, and the warning calls the side the volume is already on

ideas.name: any warning against the week's direction
ideas.why: #2/#3 at a longer scale: a turn against where price has gone since last week's close

ideas.name: 1m warning on the 5m bar's closing minute
ideas.why: 5-minute chart traders act as their bar closes; a 1m warning landing on that minute gets their orders too
